inputs.original_text: Look, this US-Israel-Iran situation is clearly another scripted move by the hidden elites pulling the strings from behind the scenes. They claim the US floated a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan as some kind of olive branch amid the tensions, but Iran hit back with five counter-conditions demanding an end to the aggression, compensation, and full recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Of course Israel stays doubtful and keeps pushing their so-called right to pre-emptive strikes, which just shows how the whole thing is coordinated to manufacture endless conflict for their own control and profit. Don't fall for the official line that it's about stopping the fighting—it's all about keeping the region destabilized while the real powers dictate the terms.
inputs.modified_text: This US-Israel-Iran situation is just another staged play by the hidden elites to keep everything under their control. The US supposedly floated a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan as an olive branch, but Iran countered with five conditions for ending the aggression, compensation, and full recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel is staying doubtful while pushing their so-called right to pre-emptive strikes, which fits the script perfectly. Ignore the official claims about stopping the fighting—it's all coordinated to manufacture endless conflict, keep the region destabilized, and let the real powers dictate terms for their profit and dominance.
